title: EV and EVSE Test and Equipment
seoDescription: Electric vehicle and EVSE test solutions from Chroma: battery, BMS, OBC and DC-DC converter, wireless charger and EVSE automatic test systems.

props.title: EV and EVSE Test and Equipment
paragraphs: Chroma's electric vehicle test solutions span the vehicle's power electronics and its charging infrastructure: battery cell and pack test, BMS and HCU ATS, OBC and DC-DC converter ATS, wireless charger and EVSE ATS, and electrical safety test.
All systems run on the PowerPro III software platform for test program editing, GO/NOGO runs and statistical reports.
